archetypes.name: dyn-bg-wait
archetypes.rationale: Changed prompt contracts decide when /design silently yields on repeat notifications.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the updated /design background-wait prose for over-broad silent-yield instructions. Verify sentinel-present and new non-empty notification cases still route to the normal post-notification sequence, and that empty-output behavior remains unchanged. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
